tia (PM): Quick thread: EnterpriseCust asked for BYOK + 5y audit lane but also wants automated attestation receipts and an "attestation-as-artifact" workflow. Can we scope this into a pilot?

omar (security): We can. Key asks: proof-of-possession for keys, signed export manifests, and an attestation artifact customers can ship to auditors (PDF + machine-readable JSON). Legal will want the artifact schema.

jin (eng-infra): Implementation idea: when onboarding BYOK we perform three automated steps: 1) key ownership proof via customer-signed nonce (OIDC or signed blob), 2) generate attestation artifact (timestamp, key ID, HSM cert chain), 3) store artifact immutably in evidence store. CLI/API to fetch artifact.

rachel (ops): Operationally we need a runbook for artifact issuance, emergency retention extensions, and legal_hold interaction. Escape hatch: allow support-only 30d extension with 2 SRE approvals + customer-signed consent stored as hash. Auto-revert after window.

marco (sales): Customer will pay for automated attestation artifact. They view it as huge time-saver for audits. Want guaranteed export SLO (they requested 24h).

omar (security): Export SLO 24h for pilot is aggressive but doable if we throttle. Must include manifest v2 with sha256 checksums, key IDs, attestation artifact reference, signed-by service key, and optional customer signature.

jin (eng-infra): API sketches:
PATCH /tenants/{id}/vault/onboard {"method":"byok","proof":"signed-nonce"}
GET /tenants/{id}/attestations/{artifact_id} -> returns artifact.pdf + artifact.json
POST /tenants/{id}/exports {"scope":"audit_logs","from":"2020-01-01","to":"2025-01-01"}

ci-bot: release pipeline: feature/attestations -> staging build 7701 queued

rachel (ops): Billing model options: (A) flat onboarding fee + per-GB archival (B) subscription band with capped spend. Ops prefers (A) for simplicity; finance prefers a capped band for large customers. Need pricing simulation.

tia (PM): Proposed pilot MVP: - BYOK onboarding (support-assisted) - Automated attestation artifact generation and immutable storage - Retention tiers (90d / 1y / 5y) with support-only 30d escape hatch - Export bundles with manifest v2 and attestation references - Billing: onboarding fee + per-GB archival; optional contract cap - Gates: attestation schema approved by legal, ops runbook, storage cost estimate, pilot customer signoff

omar (security): Gate: HSM cert chain or KMS attestation must be included for customers requiring FIPS-level proof. No GA BYOK without legal + HSM attestation.

jin (eng-infra): Risks: artifact generation increases storage and compute; searchable index on 5y still limited. Suggest metadata index for quick lookups and export-first content retrieval.

rachel (ops): Runbook items: verify-keystore-ownership, store attestation hash in audit stream, record extension approvals, how to handle legal_hold. I'll draft and link to the feature card.

marco (sales): I'll prepare a procurement-ready one-pager and ask customer if they accept support-assisted pilot. They prefer Console toggle long-term.

tia (PM): Action items: jin -> cost + perf estimate EOW; omar -> attestation schema draft Tue; rachel -> ops runbook Wed; marco -> one-pager Thu. Pilot timeline: Q2 support-assisted pilot, Q3 self-serve if gates satisfied.

ci-bot: staging build 7701 passed smoke tests

omar (security): small detail: attestation artifact must include revocation info (if key revoked) and storage location hash so auditors can verify immutability.

tia (PM): Good call. I'll add revocation fields to the schema. Thanks team.
